pre.earth_h_method: approximate Rice diagnostic; anisotropy and cross-face dependence not modeled

post.earth_h_method: approximate Rice diagnostic; anisotropy and cross-face dependence not modeled

criteria.qualified: Allan dev. at 300 s ≤ 3.0 °/h and horizontal repeatability ≤ 2.0 °/h

slip.interpretation: apparent yaw change; mount slip and changing crab can be confounded
slip.selection_policy: conservatively exclude flagged segments; no crab correction

assumptions.limitations: Finite development grid, not a bound over every admissible nuisance trajectory
